'''Jalba''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who served the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He and his fellow technician [[Prand]] were conned by [[Tanno Vik]], who commandeered their entire security team for personal reasons, leaving their outpost defenseless. Though Jalba and Prand were saved by the timely arrival of [[Havoc Squad]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], their comrades who followed Vik were much less lucky.
